correctness.rationale: For every n>=3, count proper colorings of H_(m,n)=K_(m,n) minus the matching between the m indexed pairs: partition m left vertices into p classes, k of them singletons, assign falling factorial (q)_p, and allow q-p+1 choices at each matched singleton on the right versus q-p elsewhere. Evaluate chi_H(-1) by Stanley to obtain B_(m,n); then expand forced-sink indicators. The forced-sink set must be independent, and deletion gives a bijection with acyclic orientations of G-S. Crown independent sets are precisely one-side subsets and matched two-vertex mixed pairs. Double-counted empty set is subtracted. This establishes the fully labeled polynomial for all n>=3. At n=4 the specialization is 2t(t^3+28t^2+370t+532), whose cubic discriminant is -50430544, proving nonreal roots on Q3. These are exact identities, not infinite claims from finite tests.
